  • Classes
    Class
    Description
    EmbeddedFiles
    Files embedded in the executable of the C build: the themes today, the standard library later.
    HttpC
    Reads an http(s) URL in the C build, for !include, !includesub and the other directives that read a file.
    NativeExit
    Binding to the exit function of the C library, for the exit code of the command line: System.exit does not exist in the classlib of the TeaVM C backend.
    OpenPdfResources
    Where OpenPDF finds its resources (AFM font metrics, glyph list, messages) in the C build, which has no class loader: in the files embedded in the executable, under "openpdf/" (copied from src/main/resources/org/openpdf by Gradle, see copyNativeSources).
    PngCanvas
    The RasterCanvas of the TeaVM C build: drawn by plutovg (see NativeCanvas), text with the fonts embedded in the executable (Liberation Sans, whatever the family: the other families are not embedded yet), never the fonts of the machine.
    PngImageC
    Encodes a raster image (ARGB pixels) as a PNG in C, losslessly (no palette, no packing of the channels), as javax.imageio does for an image embedded in an SVG (src/teavm-c/native/plantuml_png.h), and decodes an image file into pixels.
    PSystemBuilderC
     
    StderrStream
    The standard error of the C build, for the diagnostics of -pipe (line number and message of a syntax error, read by tools such as Kroki): the bytes are written as they are, in binary mode, straight to the file descriptor 2.
    StdinStream
    The standard input of the C build, for -pipe.
    StdoutStream
    The standard output of the C build, for -pipe: the bytes are written as they are, in binary mode.
